scripted_push_check.matching_rule: Exact mass and cube friction at float32 precision.

incidental_motion_rule: Before the first recorded grasp, cube bottom within 1 mm of table at both ends of each control step, finger-to-cube contact above the recorder threshold (0.05 N) on at least three of five physics samples, for at least two consecutive control steps. Displacement is peak horizontal distance from first state of the bout after two or more steps. The 5/10/20 mm cutoffs are exploratory. The same setting can supply a recorded lift or slip on a different attempt.
